DETERMINATION: ADVERSE DETERMINATION - MEDICAL NECESSITY

This letter is notice that Cascade Mutual has issued an adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity for the inpatient admission identified above. The requested inpatient level of care is not certified. This medical necessity denial was made following review of the submitted clinical documentation against the MCG-style criteria set edition applicable to this claim.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The clinical information submitted supports that the services rendered could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation. Inpatient level of care was therefore not established as medically necessary.

Criteria reviewed and found not met:

- PNA-02: Respiratory rate was not in the severe range.
- PNA-03: Mental status was at baseline.

No other guideline codes were applied in this review.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes apply to this determination:
CARC CO-50
RARC N115

This determination addresses medical necessity for the level of care billed. It is not a statement regarding the quality of care delivered by the treating facility or practitioner.

APPEAL RIGHTS

The member, or a provider acting as the member's authorized representative, may submit a written appeal addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on this notice. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]].

To support efficient review, the written appeal should reference each guideline code listed above and respond to the specific finding stated for that code. Submit any additional records, consultation notes, or clinical documentation that address the findings for PNA-02 and PNA-03.

The appeal must include the following physician attestation line, completed and signed by the treating or reviewing physician:

"I attest that the clinical information submitted in support of this appeal is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge." Physician signature: ______________________

A peer-to-peer discussion with a Cascade Mutual physician reviewer may be requested by contacting Utilization Management at the number listed on the member identification card.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
